snippet.title: Lost Hellden Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
Lost Hellden is a story-rich JRPG with a unique handpainted artstyle, and a brand new gameplay trailer brought viewers into its spellbinding world. Lost Hellden is coming soon to PC and consoles.
